decisions.current_model: в течение чего-либо uses final -е; в течении is a free noun phrase in prepositional case when ТЕЧЕНИЕ is the noun.
в продолжение чего-либо uses final -е; в продолжении is a free noun phrase with the noun ПРОДОЛЖЕНИЕ.
в заключение uses final -е in the prepositional/adverbial meaning 'под конец'; в заключении is a noun phrase.

current_normative_scope.впоследствии: separate lexical adverb, solid with final -и

decisions.patch_policy: Keep ВПОСЛЕДСТВИИ as current normative contrast metadata only unless exact grade-route evidence is established; do not invent a Grade-7 route.

decisions.current_model: насчёт in the meaning 'о' is a solid preposition; на счёт is a free preposition+noun phrase.
ввиду in causal meaning is a solid preposition; в виду is a free preposition+noun combination, with иметь в виду a fixed phrase.
decisions.patch_policy: Use иметь в виду as the authoritative core contrast. Do not retain держать в виду as a learner-facing anchor unless an exact dictionary/source locator is later recorded.

decisions.granularity_note: The Grade-7 source itself groups the two lexical contrasts in one candidate unit. They share the learner decision 'lexicalized solid form vs genuinely independent noun phrase'; no split is admitted in this pass.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep one contrast unit but store the two pair branches explicitly so mastery diagnostics can distinguish them without adding a second denominator identity.

decisions.current_model: несмотря на is a derivative preposition with concessive meaning; не смотря is a negated gerund meaning literally 'not looking'.
decisions.current_test: Near-synonym вопреки supports the prepositional reading; near-synonym не глядя supports the gerund reading.
чтобы is a conjunction; что бы is pronoun + particle, with бы movable/semantically separable.
тоже in additive meaning can correlate with также; то же retains demonstrative то plus particle же and can expand toward то же самое.
также in additive conjunctional meaning vs так же in manner/comparison meaning.

decisions.current_model: зато is a solid conjunction/service word; за то is preposition + pronoun when ТО retains syntactic independence.
притом is a conjunction meaning roughly 'к тому же'; при том is preposition + pronoun, e.g. при том условии, при всём при том.
причём is a solid conjunction/service word; при чём is preposition + pronoun in an independent syntactic combination.

decisions.current_function_note: оттого is primarily a pronominal adverb meaning 'по этой причине, поэтому' and can participate in conjunctional constructions such as оттого что; the canonical ID may stay stable, but learner metadata should not present every ОТТОГО use as a conjunction.
decisions.current_contrast: от того is preposition + pronoun when ТО is syntactically independent, e.g. зависит от того, что...

decisions.current_model: как будто is written separately when functioning as a conjunction or particle; no hyphen.
